subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should maintainers require live Chrome/Chromium proof of the current-main post-connect freeze before authorizing a Control UI fallback or render-trigger fix?
rationale: Source review shows plausible shell/render paths and adjacent mitigations, but the exact Chrome 146 first-render lock cannot be confirmed or closed from code inspection alone.

options.title: Require live browser proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until current-main Chrome/Chromium evidence identifies whether the shell, topbar styling, startup refresh, or another path is still freezing.

options.title: Authorize a guarded fallback
options.body: Allow a narrow safe-mode or simplified-shell fallback if maintainers decide browser-specific recovery is valuable even before the exact trigger is isolated.

options.title: Close as covered by adjacent fixes
options.body: Treat the refresh and mount-fallback fixes as sufficient despite the lack of proof for the reported pre-RPC freeze.

recommendation.title: Require live browser proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until current-main Chrome/Chromium evidence identifies whether the shell, topbar styling, startup refresh, or another path is still freezing.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the strongest feature-history trail across Dashboard v2 and the merged overlapping mitigations.
